sources.title: The transphobic murder that has shocked Colombia | International | EL PAÍS English
sources.claim_summary: News feature (14 Apr 2025): the transphobic murder of Sara Millerey, 32, a trans woman, in Bello, Antioquia - her fractured body dumped in a creek and a crowd filmed her drowning; the town had three LGBTQ murders in Q1 2025 and 13 trans people were killed nationally in Q1 2025; the president ordered an urgent investigation.

sources.title: Sara Millerey’s brutal murder shocked Colombia. The killings didn’t stop there | CNN
sources.claim_summary: News video feature (6 Aug 2025, CNN 'As Equals'): 'Viral video of her torture shocked Colombia. The killings didn't stop there' - follow-up reporting on continuing LGBTQ+ killings after the Millerey case, with gangs linked to queer and transgender deaths (crawl captured mainly navigation; full text unavailable).

sources.title: ‘We are killed for what we are’: trans women in Colombia targeted by armed groups | Global development | The Guardian
sources.claim_summary: News report (30 Jul 2024): trans women in the department of Caquetá targeted by armed groups - Tatiana Cespedes, 51, given one week to leave town or be killed; 'social cleansing' flyers and WhatsApp messages circulated; 41 trans women killed nationally in 2023 and 8 between Feb-Apr 2024; armed groups still operating despite the 2016 peace accord.
